title: Evidence retirement counted the 365-day retention from capturedAt, while the evidence-store specification and retentionEndsAt count it from publishedAt, so old evidence published today could be retired at once
resolution: The retention counts from publishedAt in the document, the contract page section 8.2, design decision 5, and the spec delta, with the scenario Old capture published recently; a test that failed before checks retentionEndsAt with different stamps and the descriptions

title: The retention refusal did not require details.retainedUntil or type it, so a refusal without it or with a non-instant value validated
resolution: RetentionRefusal requires details.retainedUntil as an Instant; the scenario Refusal without a retention end and negative tests, which failed before

title: UnknownExecution capped evidence at 64 entries, but withEvidence keeps every entry and repeated uncertain observations add one each, so a valid domain object could fail response validation
resolution: No source bounds the evidence, so the bound is removed (design decision 7, contract page section 8.4); the scenario Long evidence history and a test of 65 entries, which failed before

title: An unknown execution whose evidence held only cancellation-not-applied entries validated, though isUnknownExecution excludes it
resolution: The evidence array requires through contains an entry of another kind (contract page section 8.4); the scenario Only a cancellation that was not applied and a negative test, which failed before

title: Reconciliation pages ordered and resumed by executionId or observationId alone, which are unique only within a task or per worker, so a page boundary between equal identifiers skipped items
resolution: Order and cursors by task then execution identifier and by worker then observation identifier, next as a cursor object, paired after parameters (contract page section 8.4, design decision 7); the scenario Page boundary between equal execution identifiers and tests that failed before

title: credential-ended applied only to a fetch, so a repeated issueRunScmCredential after a revocation of the run's credential had no defined refusal
resolution: credential-ended applies to an issue too, after the remote checks, when a revocation ended the current version (ScmCredentialRefusal, contract page section 8.7, design decision 10); the scenario Issue after revocation; the refusal order is unchanged

title: The scenario Revoked slot expected revoked, but a revocation cancels the attempt (account pool section 8.1) and the earlier check attempt-not-launchable wins in section 7.3's order
resolution: The scenario names a started adopted execution whose attempt the revocation cancelled and expects attempt-not-launchable; the contract page section 8.6 states why

title: The scenario Repeated issue and the contract page promised the same version on a repeat even when a refresh came between
resolution: The promise holds only with no refresh between; the scenario Refresh between two issues, the issueRunScmCredential description, and contract page section 8.7 say a repeat after a refresh returns the refreshed version
